_source: wiki.payonstories.com/What_is_a_Poring%3F — the only place PS publishes the membership. It is prose on a dedicated page, NOT a mob-page field or a wiki Category, which is why a sweep of either finds nothing. The item API carries no script and there is no mob endpoint, so this cannot be rebuilt from tools.payonstories.com.
_note: PS-CUSTOM monster families, merged over the vanilla pre-re groups by dataLoader._mobRace2Map. The six vanilla RC2 groups (Orc, Goblin, Kobold, Golem, Guardian, Ninja) stay where they are; this file is for families PS invented.
_excluded: The wiki names exclusions explicitly and they are NOT members: Corruptor (3993), Santa Poring (1062), Stapo (1784), and every miniboss/MVP — King Poring (3994), Angeling, Deviling, Ghostring, Arcangeling. This matters more than it looks: Corruptor 3993 and King Poring 3994 sit INSIDE the 3987-3998 custom block with the real members, so any rule based on an ID range would wrongly include both.
_duplicates: Several names resolve to more than one id (Poring to five, Conductring to three). Every copy of a named Poring-type is included: they are the same monster to a player, and a bonus that applied to one Marin but not another would be a harder bug to see than one that is slightly too generous. The lv-1 trio 2510/2511/2512 is included on the same grounds.
